name: Cable-driven robot
full_name: Cable-driven continuum robot with a navigation method for semi-autonomous vascular intervention
group: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (Fei Qi, Feng Ju, Dongming Bai, Yaoyao Wang, Bai Chen) (qi2019_kinematic, affiliation of the PubMed record)
versions: 2018: modular cable-driven continuum robot for minimally invasive surgery, three sections; workspace, dexterity and a static model, with 'simulations and experiments for plane and spatial motions' (qi2018_kinematics abstract; no vessel) -> 2019: kinematics, decoupling and 'a navigation method ... to achieve semi-autonomous interventional surgery based on the vascular constraints', tested with the prototype in 'a simulated glass blood vessel' (qi2019_kinematic abstract)
target_anatomy: N.R. (blood vessels in general: 'the vascular environment is complicated and tortuous'; tested in 'a simulated glass blood vessel', qi2019_kinematic abstract)
devices_driven: its own cable-driven continuum robot, the part that enters the vessel; no off-the-shelf catheter or guidewire named (qi2019_kinematic abstract)
n_dof_detail: N.R. ('the three-section continuum robot' in qi2018_kinematics abstract; sections and feed axis of the 2019 prototype N.R. in the abstract)
translation_detail: tendon/tip-actuation (driving cables threaded through disks and fixed at the distal end, 'three guiding holes evenly distributed in the circumference of each disk with an interval of 120' degrees: alekseeva2025_design Sec. 3.2, Fig. 19b); feed by friction rollers (review-level: 'Cable-driven, Friction roller-based', alekseeva2025_design Table 12 row 8); feed not described in the abstracts
force_sensing: N.R. (a static model relates the bending shape to the driving force, qi2018_kinematics abstract; no sensor named)
haptics_leader: Novint Falcon haptic device (review-level: alekseeva2025_design Table 12 row 8); force rendering N.R.; no leader named in the abstracts
imaging_compat: X-ray (review-level: alekseeva2025_design Table 12 row 8, column Visualization); not named in the abstracts
validation_detail: phantom: 'by using the prototype, the interventional simulations and experiments for a simulated glass blood vessel are developed to validate the feasibility and maneuverability of the proposed model and navigation method' (qi2019_kinematic abstract); bench, earlier: 'simulations and experiments for plane and spatial motions' (qi2018_kinematics abstract). Number of runs and measured results N.R. in the abstracts
key_numbers: N.R. (the two abstracts give no number)
sim_model: yes: kinematic model under the piecewise-constant-curvature assumption with a decoupling algorithm, used for 'interventional simulations' (qi2019_kinematic abstract); static model by the principle of virtual work (qi2018_kinematics abstract)

notes: D2 2026-11-19: catalogued without a picture (author's rule of 2026-11-19: a missing picture does not decide inclusion). N3 2026-11-08 had judged it in scope (data/staging/uncertain_decisions_N3.csv). In scope as an actuated device: a prototype cable-driven continuum robot was navigated in a glass vessel model. The feed, leader and imaging cells rest on a review's table, not on the two papers, whose texts were not obtained. belikov2024_evolution Sec. 4.9 lists it among the tendon-actuated specialised catheters (QI1s).
